bottomFixtureInterpretation: Bottom fixtures declare Debug .defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom). For short iPad content this aligns content low, while normal default-top views are separately captured and lower content is already reachable without scrolling. These are intentional fixture views, not evidence of a user gesture final offset or normal iPad default layout.
disposition: REJECTED pre-fix candidate: AX3 tutorial marker wrapping and AI heading height instability require intentional fixes and post-fix originals.
summary: All 96 iPad/iPad AX3 originals opened at original resolution and reviewed against 21 directly opened Android originals. Normal iPad shows no material defect. AX3 tutorial markers and AI heading-height board movement confirmed in both themes; this is a rejected pre-fix candidate. All bottom counterparts reviewed for whole lower content. No additional material clipping, actor/symbol ambiguity, modal privacy or semantic style regressions observed.
